item.title: An AI agent builds an Angular form over MCP
item.description: I connected an AI agent to NGX View Builder over MCP and gave it four short prompts. It built a form, changed a validation rule, added conditional logic and translated everything to Japan, while the canvas updated live. Try it on the demo: demo.ngxviewbuilder.io/builder Docs: ngxviewbuilder.io
